anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5.reasoning: The source states: 'From 2025 to August 2026, MDEC secured close to US$44 billion in digital investments from more than 1,000 Malaysia Digital status companies.' MDEC is a government agency ('Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation'), not a company raising venture capital. The $44B represents investments MDEC facilitated/secured for the digital economy program, not capital raised by MDEC itself. This is state_funding activity (government program outcomes), not company_raise.

row.headline: MDEC chief Anuar Fariz Fadzil to exit after US$44B investment push
row.summary: Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation (MDEC) CEO Anuar Fariz Fadzil will leave the agency on October 2, 2026, at the end of his contract. His tenure focused on AI, high-value investment, and economic outcomes.
